dat4plot.sel = readRDS("/gstore/project/crc_metastasis/revision/P1P2P3P4P5_WES/controlFreeC/cnv_dat4plot.sel.rds")

pdf("/gstore/project/crc_metastasis/revision/P1P2P3P4P5_WES/controlFreeC/figures/cn_percentage_P12345.pdf")
ggplot(dat4plot.sel, aes(x=model, y=alt.perc, fill=CNVtype)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity") + 
  ylab("% of genome alteration") + xlab('') + #labs(title = title) +
  #scale_fill_discrete() +
  scale_fill_manual(name="CNV type",values=rev(c("red", "blue", gray(.8)))) +
  #scale_shape(name="Group") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size=18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

dev.off()
